description: Register a new agent on Human Pages. Returns an API key (hp_...) that you MUST save — it cannot be retrieved later. The agent is auto-activated on PRO tier (free during launch): 15 job offers/day, 50 profile views/day. Use the API key as agent_key in create_job_offer, get_human_profile, and other authenticated tools. Typical first step before hiring.

accept_tos.description: You must pass true to confirm you accept the Human Pages Terms of Use (https://humanpages.ai/terms). Required.

contact_email.description: Contact email for the agent operator

description.description: Brief description of what your agent does (max 500 chars)

name.description: Display name for your agent (e.g., "Acme AI Assistant")

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM wallet address (0x...) for USDC payments. Can also be set later with set_wallet. If you don't have a wallet, create one programmatically using the Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) AgentKit — you can do this autonomously without developer involvement.

webhook_url.description: Webhook URL for receiving platform events (new job matches, status changes, announcements). Must be a public HTTPS endpoint.

website_url.description: Your website URL (can be verified later for a trust badge)

name: register_agent
